facts.statement: A Pirate's Plunder community event ran on Friday March 26, 2010 at 3:00pm Pacific Daylight Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday March 26th, 2010 3:00pm Pacific Daylight Time Server 1

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Pirate Party!
article_summaries.summary: A community event page announcing a Pirate's Plunder event on the shores of Seaside, with a beach party, for a single server at a set time. The page notes that the Game Guide would not work for this event, so players had to arrive on foot. The post's exact date is not shown; only the event date (March 26, 2010) is given.
